claims.claim: NLI-based semantic entropy collapses to near-chance AUROC on code (Python 0.50-0.53, Java 0.48-0.56, SQL 0.47-0.58) because NLI cannot separate functionally different code.
claims.stance_target: L1: execution-graded UQ for code is OCCUPIED for closed API models
claims.scope_conditions: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-Pro/Flash/Flash-Lite; LiveCodeBench, MultiPL-E Java, LiveSQLBench
claims.quoted_support: Abstract: sampling-based methods relying on natural language inference (NLI) fail because NLI models cannot distinguish functionally different code, causing most responses to collapse into a single semantic cluster.

claims.claim: LLM-judged functional equivalence methods (functional entropy, equivalence rate, sets) achieve top AUROC in 11 of 15 model-benchmark combinations, up to 0.867 on LiveCodeBench; verbalized confidence is erratic.
claims.stance_target: L1: sampling-based functional clustering is the strong baseline
claims.scope_conditions: m=10 samples at T=1.0; judge Gemini-2.5-Flash validated at 93-97% precision against execution

claims.claim: No open-weight models, hidden-state probes, base/instruct pairs, or interventions are evaluated; all five models are closed APIs.
claims.stance_target: L2: hidden-state vs verbal comparison on open code models is not covered here
claims.quoted_support: Sec 4.1: We generate code using five large language models ... GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite

claims.claim: Execution-triggered verification is named only as future work; confidence-routed execution budgets are not tested.
claims.stance_target: L3: routing utility not tested here
claims.quoted_support: Conclusion: exploring hybrid approaches that use UQ scores to selectively trigger execution-based verification in settings where test generation is possible but expensive.

breadth.confidence_families: token-probability, NLI semantic entropy/sets, embedding/CodeBLEU similarity, functional-equivalence (LLM judge), verbalized confidence, P(True) (Sec 4.1, Tables 2-4)
breadth.reasoning_models: not present (searched: reasoning; Gemini-2.5 thinking status not stated)
breadth.elicitation_formats: verbalized confidence and P(True), one prompt each (Sec 4.1)
breadth.label_source: unit tests (Python, Java); reference query output comparison (SQL) (Sec 4.1)
breadth.label_independence: execution ground truth independent of the judge; judge validated 93-97% precision (App D)
breadth.contamination_split: LiveCodeBench cited as contamination free; no per-model release-date split (searched: cutoff)
